name: Pure Heart ~Sekai de Ichiban Anata ga Suki~
original_name: Pure Heart ～世界で一番アナタが好き～
source:
In the future there is a boom of robotics and female humanoids AI-D are developed. Main character suddenly gets a large money from a contest and decides to buy his own AI-D android. How will his living together with a robot fare?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
未来掀起了机器人热潮，女性仿生人AI-D被开发出来。主人公突然从一场比赛中获得了一大笔钱，决定购买属于自己的AI-D仿生人。他与机器人的同居生活将会如何展开？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
